verdict.rationale: Qdrant has a dedicated snapshots documentation page describing snapshots as tar archives of a collection's data and configuration on a specific node at a specific time, which covers the backup side of the story. Restore is only implied by that page; the evidence never describes the restore step itself. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the restore workflow (API/CLI steps, restoring into a new or other cluster), detail on snapshots in distributed mode beyond the per-node scope, independent or hands-on corroboration of backup/restore working.
